    The sign of a primitive new mesh under contragredient duality #

    The deleted simple for the opposite primitive idempotent is the contragredient dual of the original deleted simple. Together with reversal of the two ambient markers, this identifies positivity of the dual new mesh with vanishing of maps from the original left marker to the deleted simple. The manuscript's marker-complement theorem then turns every negative mesh into a positive dual mesh.
